title: Protocols for eDNA/eRNA Extraction from Marine Samples
author: Luca Mirimin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bz95p986
materials: QIAgen DNeasy Blood and Tissue Kit

Extract eDNA using the QIAgen DNeasy Blood and Tissue Kit, 50 rxn Qiagen Catalog #69504 following manufacturer's instructions on “ Purification of Total DNA from Animal Tissues (Spin-Column Protocol) ”, with the following modifications:
Follow subsequent steps as per manufacturer's recommendations
During the final elution phase, add 100 µL of Buffer AE Qiagen Catalog #19077 and spin through the column. Repeat the step above for a final total volume of 200 µL . Store extract at -20 °C .

Extract eDNA using the QIAgen DNeasy Blood and Tissue Kit, 50 rxn Qiagen Catalog #69504 following manufacturer's instructions on “ Purification of Total DNA from Animal Tissues (Spin-Column Protocol) ”, with the following modifications:
Follow subsequent steps as per manufacturer's recommendations

steps.title: Prepare filter membrane with beads
steps.instruction: Prepare the filter membrane for extraction using a 10 mL tube and glass beads.

substeps.instruction: Decontaminate scissors and tweezers with DNA-ExitusPlus Applychem Catalog #A7089 (or equivalent).
Cut each filter membrane in half with scissors.
Place the membrane halves into a 10 mL tube containing 0.25 g of 0.1 mm glass beads and 0.25 g of 0.5 mm glass beads (Oakton™ Glass beads for Mills Fisher Scientific or equivalent).

steps.title: Add lysis reagents
steps.instruction: Add the required lysis buffer, water, and Proteinase K to the tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 720 µL of Buffer ATL (tissue lysis buffer) Qiagen Catalog #19076.
Add 100 μL of Proteinase K, 2mL Qiagen Catalog #19131 (2 mg/L final concentration).

steps.title: Bead beat the mixture
steps.instruction: Bead beat the mixture for 00:15:00 at half speed using a Mixer Mill MM 400 (Retsch, MM400) or equivalent.

steps.title: Extract eDNA
steps.instruction: Extract eDNA using the PowerMax® Soil DNA Isolation Kit Mobio Catalog #12988-10 following manufacturer's instructions.

steps.title: Co-extract eDNA and eRNA
steps.instruction: Co-extract eDNA and eRNA using ZR-Duet™ DNA/RNA MiniPrep Plus Zymo Research Catalog #D7003 following manufacturer's recommendations.

substeps.instruction: Include a negative control in the DNA isolation step (same components but no starting material) processed alongside samples to monitor cross-contamination.

steps.title: Reverse Transcribe eRNA
steps.instruction: Reverse Transcribe eRNA into cDNA using SuperScript II reverse transcription kit Life Technologies or equivalent kit.

steps.title: Process high volume water sub-sample
steps.instruction: Prepare a water sub-sample from a high volume tow net collection.

substeps.instruction: Mix the sample by briefly vortexing.
Place a 15 mL sub-sample into a new clean 50 mL falcon tube (conical bottom).
Centrifuge at max speed to form a pellet.

steps.title: Add lysis reagents to sub-sample
steps.instruction: Add lysis reagents to the pellet and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 1350 µL of Buffer ATL (tissue lysis buffer) Qiagen Catalog #19076.
Add 100 µL Proteinase K, 2mL Qiagen Catalog #19131.
Follow manufacturer's recommendations for all subsequent steps.

steps.title: Extract eDNA from 5 g sub-sample
steps.instruction: Extract eDNA from a 5 g sub-sample using PowerMax® Soil DNA Isolation Kit Mobio Catalog #12988-10 following manufacturer's recommendations.
